Fully compatible with Intel ATX 3.1 specifications, Toughpower GX3 850W is engineered to support modern high-performance systems and next-generation hardware with stable and efficient power delivery.
Equipped with a native PCIe Gen5.1 12+4pin connector, Toughpower GX3 850W confidently powers next-generation graphics cards while meeting ATX 3.1 power excursion requirements.
1. Recommended wattage is an estimation of system power demand. Actual power demands may vary based on specific components, usage, and many other factors.
2. Please follow the recommended power requirements from the GPU manufactures before using the 12VHPWR cable.
A powerful single +12V rail combined with DC-DC conversion ensures stable, consistent, and precise power delivery for demanding CPU and GPU workloads.
Low-profile flat black cables simplify cable management and help improve airflow inside the chassis.

Built-in protections including Over Current Protection (OCP), Over Voltage Protection (OVP), Under Voltage Protection (UVP), Over Power Protection (OPP), Over Temperature Protection (OTP), and Short Circuit Protection (SCP) safeguard your system against electrical faults, providing peace of mind and reliable operation.
Certified 80 PLUS Gold with up to 90% efficiency under typical load conditions, reducing wasted energy and minimizing heat generation.
With a compact 140mm depth, Toughpower GX3 750W fits easily into a wide range of ATX cases, offering flexible installation options.
